pr_body:
Add a `max_tabs` option to the settings that ensure no more than this amount of tabs are open in a pane. If set to `null`, there is no limit.

Closes #4784

Release Notes:

- Added a `max_tabs` option to cap the maximum number of open tabs.
pr_comments: Nice test! If we get this branch back up to date, and fix that documentation issue, I'd be happy to merge this :)
Yeah!! Thank you! I'm so eager to have it released 😄

issue_context.title: Settings to control max tabs open
issue_context.body:
### Check for existing issues

- [X] Completed

### Describe the feature

It would be nice to have a setting in zed that allows to configure the max amount tabs that can be open.

Like in IntelliJ products, I typically set my max to 1 so my IDE can only have one tab open at a time that I'm working on. I then use the shortcut for opening recent files to navigate where else I need to if I'm working through multiple files.

Let me know what you guys think. I still have to check if there is already an open issue to allow a shortcut to open recent files.

### If applicable, add mockups / screenshots to help present your vision of the feature


_No response_

review_comments:
Currently the max_tab algorithm only runs when a new tab is created, hence this test order.

Maybe we could consider removing tabs when max_tabs is set. I don't know that we have these kind of hooks in the codebase, and I'm not sure it is that important (I feel like it would be set once in while as a global setting by a user anyway).

EDIT: I found that a hook exist, but it would add a lot of code for something that is not necessary imho.
